# FLX-2301: the run's cast does not resolve

**Family:** plan/replay binding (the 2000 band)

A reference in the Simulation's closure names a document the bundle does not carry, of a kind that reference may not name, or -- for a Journey or a Detector -- one reached by a route other than moduleRefs -&gt; Module.spec.resources. A cast that does not resolve cannot be planned, so the run stops rather than executing a subset of what the documents describe.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-2301
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
